title: Astra Data Factory source config, version 0
description: One versioned instance of a Source Spec mapped to a canonical model under a Target Profile, with rules, DQ rules and resolution parameters (product spec Section 4). Version 0 fixes identity, ownership, references and mappings; the compiler (S3.1.1) resolves every reference and checks mapping types.

config_version.description: Schema version this file is written against.

id.description: Unique source id; the file must be named <id>.yaml.

family.description: Layout family assigned by the Pattern Matcher.

id.description: Source Spec id in the spec registry.

pattern.description: Pattern library id that parses the spec (fixed_width_multi_record, delimited_file). Optional: the first pattern that handles the spec is used when absent.

target_profile.description: A target profile the factory has renderers for (snowflake_iceberg).

domain_pack.description: A domain pack under domains/; its latest canonical model is the target.

effective_from.description: Business date from which this config is in force.

source.description: Field name of the spec's logical record, as the spec names it

constant.description: A fixed value for the column, typed by the column (a code, a currency, a date written as YYYY-MM-DD).

record.description: Logical record of the spec the field belongs to; required when the spec has more than one.

transform.description: A transform call, name(arguments), from the vocabulary the renderers implement (signed_implied_decimal, implied_decimal, negate, trim, upper, to_date, nullif).

rule.description: Rule catalog id that governs this mapping; must be listed under rules.

rules.description: Ids of rule catalog entries (rules/<group>/<name>.yaml) this config depends on. A mapping's rule must be listed here; the catalog says what each rule is, who owns it and its status.

kind.description: What the rule measures; each kind becomes one data metric function or one association (S3.2.7)

level.description: file for a control total; record measures a physical record's Bronze table; pair and business measure the Silver table of the logical record

check.description: The rule in words, for the docs and the metric's comment

record.description: Detail record measured; needed when the spec has several

field.description: The field measured (not_null, accepted_values, range; the summed field of a control total)

fields.description: unique: the fields that identify a row

trailer_field.description: control_total: the trailer field carrying the total

aggregate.description: control_total: count of the record's rows (default) or sum of field

values.description: accepted_values: the values the field may hold

condition.description: condition: SQL over the table's columns that every row must satisfy

document.description: Document the check comes from; defaults to the spec's layout document

citation.description: Where the check is stated; defaults to the citation of the field the rule measures

resolution.description: How custodian identifiers become platform identifiers, as set-based joins against the replicated reference data (ADR 0015), with the rejection code each failure raises. Codes default to the feed's; every code must be in the taxonomy.

feed.description: Reference-data feed with the account cross-reference (default account_xref).

source.description: Source field carrying the custodian's account number.

require_open.description: A closed account is an exception (closed code).

feed.description: Reference-data feed with the security master (default security_master).

by.description: Identifiers tried in this order: the first with exactly one match resolves the security; several matches is ambiguous.

identifier.description: An identifier of the feed: CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, TICKER, OCC_SYMBOL

require_active.description: An inactive security is an exception (inactive code) rather than a warning.

source.description: Source field carrying the custodian's transaction code.

map.description: Custodian code to canonical transaction type (BUY, SELL, DIVIDEND, ...).

unmapped.description: Raised for a code the map does not have (default TRANSACTION_CODE_UNMAPPED).

when.description: Take the price from SILVER.PRICE when the source has none, or always.

missing.description: Raised when no price is found within the lookback (default PRICE_MISSING).

orphan_policy.description: A held row (any resolution above) is never dropped -- this only names how long, per this custodian, it may sit unresolved before it is a stale-orphan concern rather than a routine one, the same shape reference-data.yaml's own expected_every_hours already established for a feed's own freshness.

grace_hours.description: Hours a held row may wait for the reference data it needs before it counts as an aged orphan (default 24).

processing.description: How the source is processed. target_lag_minutes is the TARGET_LAG of the parsed dynamic tables and the interval of the process task (default 15).

delivery.description: When the custodian delivers and which files are expected every business day. Drives the 'late' alert (S1.2.4) and the custodian's Tasks DAG, which starts when every expected file of a business date has arrived (S3.2.6). Shared by every source of the same custodian; sources must agree.

refresh_expected_every_days.description: A full refresh file is expected at least this often; when none has been merged for longer, a refresh_stale alert is raised at the custodian's late severity.

pattern.description: SQL LIKE pattern of the file path relative to the landing prefix, for example pershing/GCUS_%_POS_%.dat

alerts.description: Alert severity for this custodian. Both default to error.

late.description: Severity of the alert raised when expected files are missing after the cutoff

task_failure.description: Severity of the alert raised when one of the custodian's tasks fails

rejection_code.description: A code of the domain pack's rejection taxonomy
